item.title: EAF + ASU: assess electrical demand and oxygen supply as one system
item.company_name: U. S. Steel Košice / Nippon Steel
item.project: Engineering lesson derived from the announced EAF + ASU investment programme
item.technology: EAF electrical load integration + ASU utility integration
item.project_status: Engineering guidance based on an announced, not yet commissioned, investment programme
item.project_status_evidence: Nippon Steel official release confirms the EAF and ASU investment decision and target dates; the engineering recommendation is IIG analysis.
item.company_context:
U. S. Steel Košice is a Slovak steelworks within Nippon Steel.

The project combines a major electric arc furnace investment with an air separation unit.

For FEED and grid studies, EAF demand, ASU demand, connection capacity and operating profiles should be assessed together.

advice.problem: EAF and ASU loads can be underestimated when electrical and utility interfaces are studied separately.
advice.checks: Verify coincident EAF and ASU load profiles, grid connection limits, power quality, redundancy philosophy and operating modes before design freeze.
advice.technical_solution: Develop one integrated electrical and utility design basis, model coincident demand and disturbances, and size connection and reserve architecture against verified operating cases.
advice.management_decision: Do not approve grid capacity, major electrical procurement or final interface limits until the integrated EAF–ASU study and design basis are signed.

item.title: AI data centers: lock grid, backup and heat-reuse assumptions before CAPEX
item.project: Engineering lesson derived from the announced Finnish AI infrastructure programme
item.technology: Grid connection + backup generation + waste-heat integration
item.project_status: Engineering guidance based on an announced investment programme; site-specific design remains prospective
item.project_status_evidence: Google's official release establishes the investment programme; the engineering checklist is IIG analysis, not a Google performance claim.
item.company_context:
Google operates cloud, AI and data-center infrastructure.

AI infrastructure creates material electrical connection, redundancy and cooling requirements.

Before fixing CAPEX, industrial data-center studies should reconcile grid capacity, backup philosophy, load profile and recoverable heat.

advice.problem: AI data-center CAPEX can be fixed before grid capacity, backup philosophy, cooling demand and recoverable heat are reconciled.
advice.checks: Verify utility connection capacity, phased IT load, redundancy level, backup runtime, cooling architecture, BESS role and heat-reuse boundary conditions.
advice.technical_solution: Build a staged energy balance and reliability model linking grid, backup generation, BESS, cooling and heat-reuse interfaces before equipment sizing.
advice.management_decision: Do not freeze electrical CAPEX or procure major backup and storage equipment until the load cases and resilience design basis are approved.

PURPOSE OF THE WORKSHOP: The Workshop was held as Viet Nam entered a new stage of development, marked by the need for rapid and sustainable growth, accelerated industrialization and modernization, digital transformation, and a comprehensive energy transition. Electricity demand for production, digital infrastructure, urban development, transport, and people’s daily lives continues to grow rapidly. Against this backdrop, Viet Nam must pursue its commitment to achieving net-zero emissions by 2050 and reducing its dependence on fossil fuels, while safeguarding national energy security amid significant international uncertainties.

The project has the following key details: The project will be implemented in Hong Loc Commune. The project is expected to use approximately 55.5 hectares of land, including the solar power plant area, auxiliary facilities, grid connection facilities, and the expansion of a feeder bay at the Can Loc 110 kV Substation. The project will have a designed capacity of 49 MW, with an expected average annual electricity output of approximately 68.62 million kWh. The total investment capital is estimated at VND 763.312 billion. The project will have an operating term of 50 years, starting from the date on which the State allocates or leases the land. The project will have an implementation period of 12 months from the date on which the land is allocated or leased. The project is expected to be completed in Q4 2027. To ensure that the project is implemented in accordance with regulations and on schedule, the People’s Committee of Ha Tinh Province has requested the following: Requirements for the investor First, before the State allocates or leases the land, the investor must complete the procedures for making a security deposit or implementing other measures to secure project implementation in accordance with investment laws, within a period of no more than six months from the effective date of the Decision. Second, the investor must complete all required documents and procedures and commence construction of the project within six months from the effective date of the Decision.

Báo cáo tổng hợp kiến nghị từ Diễn đàn năng lượng sạch Việt Nam (lần thứ 6) tới Chính phủ Từ các tham luận, thảo luận tại “Diễn đàn Năng lượng sạch Việt Nam lần thứ 6”, do Hiệp hội Năng lượng Việt Nam (VEA) phối hợp với các cơ quản lý nhà nước chủ trì, Tạp chí Năng lượng Việt Nam tổ chức thực hiện, với chủ đề “Điện mặt trời, lưu trữ năng lượng ở Việt Nam - Thành tựu, thách thức và cơ hội phát triển giai đoạn 2026-2030” [*], Ban tổ chức Diễn đàn vừa có Báo cáo tổng hợp gửi tới Thủ tướng Chính phủ Lê Minh Hưng xem xét, chỉ đạo việc thúc đẩy phát triển năng lượng sạch, lưu trữ năng lượng và nâng cao khả năng chống chịu của hệ thống điện Việt Nam. Dưới đây là một số nội dung chính của Báo cáo. Hệ thống BESS tại Trạm biến áp 110 kV Phúc Sơn trước khi nghiệm thu, đóng điện. Hệ thống được lắp đặt tại Trạm biến áp 110 kV Phúc Sơn (E23.17), có công suất 5 MW và dung lượng lưu trữ 10 MWh.
